summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BookSlot smart booking with conflict detection and approval workflow. Fixed a critical datetime comparison bug in public booking endpoint. All 17 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified for all key features.

fixed.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes
fixed.fix: Added timezone-naive conversion for datetime comparisons in working hours and break time checks

critical_code_review_comments: Smart booking conflict detection working correctly - returns 409 with alternative_times, alternative_staff, alternative_days
Approval workflow working - approve/reject endpoints update appointment status correctly
Notification bell shows pending count and redirects to Calendar
Help button opens quick help panel with useful tips
Logo upload button present in Settings page (storage integration working)
Navigation cleaned up - no Resources, Forms, Messages, Integrations tabs visible
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created during testing (test_booking@example.com, test_conflict1@example.com, test_approve@example.com, test_reject@example.com, ui_test_fixed@example.com)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart booking and approval workflow fully tested. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_smart_booking_approval.py cover: public booking page, availability endpoint, booking creation, conflict detection (409 with alternatives), approve/reject endpoints, file upload, branding settings, notification settings. Frontend verified via Playwright for dashboard, calendar, settings pages, notification bell, help button, and public booking flow.

bug_fixed.description: TypeError in public booking endpoint when comparing timezone-aware and timezone-naive datetimes
bug_fixed.root_cause: datetime.fromisoformat() returns timezone-aware datetime, but datetime.strptime() returns timezone-naive datetime
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added timezone-naive conversion using .replace(tzinfo=None) before comparisons
bug_fixed.verification: All 17 backend tests pass, UI booking flow works correctly
